issues.detail: The Greek 'δεξιας' (dexias) is an adjective/participle related to 'right hand' or 'right side'. The Vietnamese translation 'đã trao tay hữu cho tôi' (gave the right hand to me) is a literal and nonsensical rendering of the spatial/relational concept in this context, likely misinterpreting the prepositional/adjectival use.

The Greek 'κοινωνιας' (koinonias) is a genitive modifying the action of giving; the Vietnamese 'về sự thông công' (about/regarding fellowship) captures the word but misses the specific grammatical relationship of 'giving [to] fellowship' or 'giving [for] fellowship' as intended in the context of the gift.
